title: Life cycle assessment of plasma gasification integrated molten carbonate fuel cells and chemical looping reforming using RDF feedstock
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,627-639
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01338G, Paper
Roni Mallick, Prabu Vairakannu
Plasma gasification is a promising technology for integration with molten carbonate fuel cell (MCFC) and chemical looping reforming (CLR) process for effective utilization of refused derived fuels.
